n0c2cafda6b.headline: Elemental Altus and EMX Announce Completion of Merger
n0c2cafda6b.summary: Elemental Altus Royalties and EMX Royalty Corporation have announced completion of their merger, dated November 13, 2025. Both are listed on Canadian and US exchanges.
n0c2cafda6b.why: Royalty companies fund mining projects in exchange for revenue streams, so mergers reshape the scale and portfolio of listed mining royalty providers.

n363e5bf299.headline: Apartments lead Cyprus property growth as retail lags behind
n363e5bf299.summary: Cyprus's real estate market showed resilient but mixed performance in the third quarter of 2025, according to the RICS Cyprus Property Price Index. Apartments led growth while retail lagged.
n363e5bf299.why: Property price indices track residential and commercial real estate conditions, which feed into bank mortgage books and construction activity.

n648b3cfcf9.headline: DMO allots N3.83 billion in November 2025 savings bonds
n648b3cfcf9.summary: The Debt Management Office released allotment results for its November 2025 savings bond offer. Results confirmed robust investor interest in both the 2-year and 3-year maturities.
n648b3cfcf9.why: Government savings bonds are a funding tool for the public debt, and their demand signals domestic investor appetite for sovereign paper.

nb732b67acb.headline: Cell C’s sale of up to 173.4-million shares opens ahead of JSE debut
nb732b67acb.summary: The sale of up to 173.4 million Cell C shares has opened ahead of its Johannesburg Stock Exchange debut. The offer price ranges between R29.50 and R35.50 per share.
nb732b67acb.why: Cell C is a South African mobile operator, and a listing on the JSE gives investors public equity exposure to the telecom sector in South Africa.

n7037c97bf6.headline: Eicher Motors Ltd. Q2 Profit Rises
n7037c97bf6.summary: Eicher Motors reported higher second-quarter earnings than a year earlier, with net profit of INR13.695 billion. The company is the parent of Royal Enfield motorcycles.
n7037c97bf6.why: Eicher Motors is an Indian automaker whose Royal Enfield unit is a major maker of mid-size motorcycles.

neac0148717.headline: MTBPS: ACDP, ActionSA bemoan low economic growth, illicit trade respectively
neac0148717.summary: Economic growth forecasts have fallen from 1.9% at the start of the year to 1.2% at present, according to the medium-term budget policy statement debate.
neac0148717.why: The medium-term budget policy statement sets South Africa's fiscal path, and growth forecasts shape tax revenue, debt sustainability and investor confidence.

n09c0d403a3.headline: Treasury: Process of axing almost 9k ghost workers from govt payroll started
n09c0d403a3.summary: South Africa's National Treasury said the process of removing almost 9,000 ghost workers from the government payroll has started. It flagged 8,854 cases of people receiving payments from multiple departments.
n09c0d403a3.why: Public payroll costs are a major component of South African government spending, which affects fiscal deficits and sovereign debt metrics.

nd51451f62d.headline: 'Their loss': Ramaphosa says US snub won't stop G20 summit
nd51451f62d.summary: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa said the US decision to boycott will not stop the G20 summit. He said boycotting never achieves anything of great impact.
nd51451f62d.why: The G20 brings together major economies to coordinate economic and financial policy, so participation affects global policy coordination.

ncaaa9944a4.headline: Liberals promise more coal and gas under climate policy
ncaaa9944a4.summary: The Liberal opposition is promising cheaper power prices under a plan to abandon climate change targets. The plan would expand coal and gas use.
ncaaa9944a4.why: Australia's electricity policy shapes energy costs and the outlook for coal, gas and renewable generators.

n4f8794181b.headline: Sterling edges up, gains tempered by soft UK growth data
n4f8794181b.summary: The pound rose on Thursday as a Washington deal to reopen the US government drew investors to riskier assets. Gains were tempered by soft UK growth data.
n4f8794181b.why: Sterling is the UK currency and is sensitive to growth data, Bank of England expectations and global risk sentiment. Its moves affect UK importers, exporters and overseas investors.

n6cc6cdef55.headline: China October M2 money supply +8.2% vs +8.1% y/y expected
n6cc6cdef55.summary: China's M2 money supply rose 8.2% year on year in October, against 8.1% expected. The data covers the latest credit figures for October 2025.
n6cc6cdef55.why: M2 is a broad measure of money supply that signals liquidity and credit conditions in the world's second-largest economy. Investors track it for clues on stimulus and growth.

ndfc0449577.headline: Iran comes up with initiative to mint joint investment platform with Kyrgyzstan
ndfc0449577.summary: Iran has proposed setting up a joint platform to promote investment opportunities in Kyrgyzstan. The initiative was announced by the governor of Razavi Khorasan Province.
ndfc0449577.why: Cross-border investment platforms can open trade and capital flows between Iran and Central Asian economies, which are relevant to sanctions-affected trade routes.

n4287e48f83.headline: AADE: Transactions Subject to Digital Tax Explained
n4287e48f83.summary: Greece's tax authority AADE has published guidance on which transactions are subject to the country's digital tax. Covered transactions include leases, loans and mortgage registrations.
n4287e48f83.why: Transaction taxes on lending and property deals affect the cost and volume of credit and real estate activity in Greece.

n720db58f8f.headline: Greece-Cyprus Cable Revival: Geopolitical Shifts & US Role
n720db58f8f.summary: The Greece-Cyprus electricity interconnector is back on track after political hurdles, with US and EU backing challenging Turkey's regional ambitions.
n720db58f8f.why: Power interconnectors link electricity grids and can improve energy security and trade between neighbouring countries.

nd4972bb720.headline: Nigeria Scraps Plans for Fuel Import Duty in Blow to Local Refiners
nd4972bb720.summary: Nigeria has abandoned plans to impose a 15% duty on imported refined petroleum products, a move that undercuts the new private refinery owned by Aliko Dangote.
nd4972bb720.why: Nigeria is a major African oil producer, and import duties on refined fuel shape competition between imports and domestic refining.

n9ec6d0177f.headline: UK economic growth slows ahead of Budget after JLR shutdown
n9ec6d0177f.summary: The Office for National Statistics said UK gross domestic product grew by 0.1% between July and September, ahead of the Budget, after the JLR shutdown.
n9ec6d0177f.why: GDP growth is the main measure of the UK economy and shapes expectations for interest rates and fiscal policy.

nebfac69663.headline: Homeowner repossessions up 51 in a year but figures ‘below long-term average’
nebfac69663.summary: UK home repossessions rose by 51 over the past year, according to UK Finance, though the figures remain below their long-term average. The number of mortgages in arrears has fallen.
nebfac69663.why: Mortgage arrears and repossessions are indicators of household financial stress in the UK, relevant to lenders and the housing market.

n9021c983df.headline: ADC blasts Tinubu over fresh loans, urges halt on non-critical borrowing
n9021c983df.summary: The African Democratic Congress condemned the Federal Government's recent approval of N1.15 trillion in domestic borrowing and urged a halt to non-critical borrowing.
n9021c983df.why: Domestic borrowing by Nigeria's government affects public debt levels and naira-denominated government bond markets.

n019258a24b.headline: House passes bill to end longest US government shutdown; Trump signs measure
n019258a24b.summary: The House passed legislation ending the 43-day shutdown, the longest in US history. The bill keeps the government open until Jan. 30, 2026, and Trump signed it.
n019258a24b.why: A federal shutdown halts many government services and delays data releases, which affects economic growth expectations and investor sentiment toward US assets.
n019258a24b.why_moved: The end of a record-length shutdown removes a source of fiscal and political uncertainty that had weighed on sentiment, as the input describes a funding bill signed into law.

nf3c8ac6e7a.headline: Swiss franc strength overdone, EUR/CHF longs attractive again - JP Morgan
nf3c8ac6e7a.summary: JP Morgan says the Swiss franc should not be trading so strongly given the current macro backdrop, and that EUR/CHF long positions are attractive again.
nf3c8ac6e7a.why: The Swiss franc is a traditional safe-haven currency, and its moves against the euro affect Swiss exporters and European currency positioning.

nd2fcf274fe.headline: Aurora Mobile (JG) Q3 2025 Earnings Transcript
nd2fcf274fe.summary: Aurora Mobile, a Chinese mobile marketing and data company, published its transcript for the third quarter of 2025 earnings call. The excerpt provided contains only the opening remarks.
nd2fcf274fe.why: Aurora Mobile is a Shenzhen-based provider of mobile internet marketing and data services, and its quarterly results are watched by investors in Chinese internet advertising.

n04753e4f84.headline: Will the Fed pause in December?
n04753e4f84.summary: Most investors are betting on a December rate cut, but a lack of data and divisions within the Fed could lead to a status quo at its next meeting.
n04753e4f84.why: The Federal Reserve sets the US federal funds rate, which influences borrowing costs, bond yields and equity valuations worldwide.

n5ba9143af4.headline: Investor accounts on NSE surpass 24 crore
n5ba9143af4.summary: The National Stock Exchange said the number of unique trading accounts surpassed 24 crore this month, reaching the milestone within about a year.
n5ba9143af4.why: The National Stock Exchange of India is the country's largest exchange by volume, and rising account numbers reflect growing retail participation.

n2499697e09.headline: Liberals promise more coal and gas under climate policy
n2499697e09.summary: The Liberals are promising cheaper power prices under a plan to abandon climate change targets. The policy would expand coal and gas generation.
n2499697e09.why: Australia's energy policy shapes electricity prices and the outlook for coal, gas and renewable investment. Policy shifts can change long-term energy sector returns.

n12ab6859a0.headline: Rate cut hopes evaporate with healthy jobs figures
n12ab6859a0.summary: Shares have plunged and the Australian dollar has soared after surprisingly robust jobs figures showed the economy is holding up, dimming rate-cut hopes.
n12ab6859a0.why: The Australian share market is benchmarked by the S&P/ASX 200, and the Australian dollar is sensitive to shifts in the Reserve Bank of Australia's interest-rate outlook.
n12ab6859a0.why_moved: Robust jobs figures showed the economy is resilient, which reduced hopes of interest-rate cuts. Shares fell while the Australian dollar strengthened.

nc70bf2ecba.headline: Tencent Holdings Limited Reveals Climb In Q3 Profit
nc70bf2ecba.summary: Tencent Holdings reported third-quarter earnings that increased from a year earlier. Earnings totaled RMB63.13 billion, according to RTTNews.
nc70bf2ecba.why: Tencent is a major Chinese internet, gaming and social media conglomerate, and its results are a key indicator of China's tech sector.

na0531a93e9.headline: Australian economy 'island of security' in risky seas
na0531a93e9.summary: A shock fall in unemployment has surprised analysts and dashed hopes of further interest rate cuts. The treasurer has highlighted Australia's economic strength.
na0531a93e9.why: Unemployment and labour market data feed directly into the Reserve Bank of Australia's interest rate decisions, which affect borrowing costs and the currency.
na0531a93e9.why_moved: A shock fall in unemployment surprised analysts and reduced hopes for further interest rate cuts.

n227a632189.headline: Supply Chain Law: EU Parliament Voted for Weakening
n227a632189.summary: The European Parliament voted again on changes to the supply chain law and sustainability reporting proposed by the European Commission, which would weaken them.
n227a632189.why: EU supply chain due diligence and sustainability reporting rules set obligations for large European companies and their suppliers. Changes to these rules affect compliance costs and reporting requirements across European industry.

ndac88bf446.headline: Autocanada Inc Bottom Line Advances In Q3
ndac88bf446.summary: AutoCanada reported third-quarter profit of C$16.10 million, or C$0.66 per share, up from last year.
ndac88bf446.why: AutoCanada is a Canadian automotive retailer operating dealerships, so its earnings signal demand in the vehicle retail market.

n8c2cc538da.headline: Diageo to spend additional €257.5m to double capacity of Kildare Brewery
n8c2cc538da.summary: Diageo plans to double brewery capacity at its Kildare site, bringing its overall investment in the area to an estimated €457.5 million.
n8c2cc538da.why: Diageo is a global spirits and beer company, and its brewery investments affect its production capacity and Irish operations.

impacts.name: Diageo
impacts.why: A capacity expansion means additional capital spending at a Diageo brewery.

nf54f276f88.headline: Japanese Chip Sector’s Earnings Show AI Appetite, Auto Slump | Company Business News
nf54f276f88.summary: AI-driven data center demand led to a stronger-than-expected earnings season for Japan's tech sector, with chipmakers and equipment suppliers raising forecasts while auto-related firms slumped.
nf54f276f88.why: Japan hosts major semiconductor and chip equipment makers that supply global AI and data center buildouts.

n978f035653.headline: Stocks continue the tumble.  Nasdaq moves toward down 2% before bouncing modestly.
n978f035653.summary: The Nasdaq moved toward a 2% decline before a modest bounce, with Nvidia down close to 4%. European shares also declined after reaching record highs earlier this week.
n978f035653.why: The Nasdaq is heavily weighted toward large technology companies, and Nvidia is a major AI chip supplier whose share price influences the index.

impacts.why: Nvidia shares fell close to 4%, weighing on the index.

nc387da7caa.headline: Wildbrain Reports Q1 2026 Results
nc387da7caa.summary: WildBrain, a global kids' and family entertainment company based in Toronto, released its Q1 2026 operational and financial highlights. The results were published on November 13, 2025.
nc387da7caa.why: WildBrain is a Canadian-listed kids' entertainment company whose results reflect its content and licensing business.

n6260cfb38b.headline: HBM4 bets propel Samsung on new bullish run
n6260cfb38b.summary: Samsung Electronics shares are trading above 100,000 won, about $68. Investors are questioning whether the company can sustain its rally on HBM4 memory bets.
n6260cfb38b.why: Samsung is a major global maker of memory chips, and high-bandwidth memory is a key component of AI accelerators.

nd7d8691141.headline: Deal after dinner as Trump signs end to shutdown
nd7d8691141.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump signed a bill ending the longest U.S. government shutdown on record, in a late-night ceremony. The article is a preview of the day ahead in European and global markets.
nd7d8691141.why: A US government shutdown delays federal data releases and spending, and its resolution is watched by investors for effects on US growth and Treasury markets.
nd7d8691141.why_moved: The end of the shutdown removes a prolonged source of uncertainty over US federal operations and the economic data flow.

nf4e5d4cbfe.headline: Steel Hawk subsidiary bags RM35.04mil data centre electrical job
nf4e5d4cbfe.summary: Steel Hawk Engineering Sdn Bhd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Steel Hawk Bhd, secured a RM35.04 million contract from Binalite Electrical Engineering. The job is a 275kV bulk supply connection to a data centre in southern Peninsular Malaysia.
nf4e5d4cbfe.why: Steel Hawk is a Malaysian engineering group, and data centre infrastructure contracts reflect demand for power and electrical capacity.

n0c67e949e5.headline: Disney raises dividend 50% as streaming profits surge
n0c67e949e5.summary: Disney raised its dividend by 50% and doubled share buybacks to $7 billion. Streaming and parks drove quarterly earnings above Wall Street estimates.
n0c67e949e5.why: Disney is a major US media and entertainment conglomerate, and its streaming and theme park businesses are key drivers of its earnings.

n3e7d002689.headline: Switzerland forecasts 1.5 GW annual solar growth through 2027
n3e7d002689.summary: Swissolar's Solar Monitor 2025 projects annual photovoltaic additions of about 1.5 GW through 2027. The report urges policymakers to sustain steady growth amid policy uncertainty and lower tariffs.
n3e7d002689.why: Solar capacity growth shapes demand for panels, installers and grid investment, and it is influenced by subsidy and tariff policy.

n1628e426cc.headline: Property market cooling: central bank - Taipei Times
n1628e426cc.summary: Taiwan's central bank said the local property market has cooled moderately after credit control measures designed to curb speculation. It remained tight-lipped on potential rule relaxations.
n1628e426cc.why: Central bank credit controls on property lending influence housing prices, household credit and bank asset quality.

n08432cf705.headline: USMEF focuses on growing meat export demand amid trade challenges
n08432cf705.summary: USMEF President and CEO Dan Halstrom says the group is focused on growing meat export demand and defending current free trade agreements, citing Canada and Mexico under USMCA.
n08432cf705.why: US meat exports are a significant outlet for American livestock producers, so trade rules directly affect packers and producers.

n3467e14f13.headline: US ‘strike force’ to target scam centers in Southeast Asia - Taipei Times
n3467e14f13.summary: The US Department of Justice announced a new Scam Center Strike Force to combat a surge in cryptocurrency investment fraud by transnational criminal groups operating out of Southeast Asia.
n3467e14f13.why: Crypto investment fraud erodes investor trust and can lead to enforcement actions against exchanges and intermediaries.

nfdaf8a1eb8.headline: Olympia Financial Group Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2025 Results
nfdaf8a1eb8.summary: Olympia Financial Group, listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange as OLY, announced its operating and financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2025.
nfdaf8a1eb8.why: Olympia Financial Group is a Calgary-based Canadian financial company listed on the TSX.

n365e6d8037.headline: Canadian Stocks Tumble Amid Profit Taking Following Recent Gains
n365e6d8037.summary: Canadian stocks slumped on Thursday as investors took profits from the previous day's surge and the two sessions before it. The sell-off followed a run of gains.
n365e6d8037.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main benchmark index, and it is heavily weighted toward banks, energy and materials.
n365e6d8037.why_moved: Investors booked profits after several sessions of gains, according to the report.

n0351d88018.headline: Team (TISI) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
n0351d88018.summary: Team Inc said revenue grew almost 7%, or about $14 million, year over year. Its adjusted EBITDA margin rose to 28.6%, the highest third-quarter level in several years.
n0351d88018.why: Team Inc is an industrial inspection and maintenance services company, and its results reflect demand from energy and process-industry clients.

ncee9b96c7c.headline: President Lee launches “6 major structural reforms” including finance and labor… “Rebounding potential growth is the biggest challenge”-Politics | Hankook Ilbo
ncee9b96c7c.summary: President Lee Jae-myung is pushing six structural reforms covering regulation, finance, the public sector, pensions, education and labour. The government aims to address weakening potential growth.
ncee9b96c7c.why: Structural reforms in labour, pensions and financial regulation shape long-term growth, corporate costs and the outlook for Korean equities and the won.

n17149016a0.headline: Dubai Multi Commodities Centre and Blockmaze cooperate on developing tokenized assets and digital trade infrastructure
n17149016a0.summary: Dubai Multi Commodities Centre and Blockmaze, a company of the Finvasia Group, discussed opportunities to develop tokenisation of real-world assets and digital trade infrastructure. No deal terms are given.

nc09578d8de.headline: Liberals scrap net zero after months of infighting
nc09578d8de.summary: The Liberal Party in Australia has abandoned its pledge to achieve net zero emissions by 2050 following months of internal disputes.
nc09578d8de.why: Climate policy shifts affect energy markets, regulatory environment, and investor expectations in Australia.
